long_window_secs.description: Long-window (slow scan) tier window. Default 21600 (6 h).

long_threshold.description: Distinct ports within long_window_secs to ban (detector name port_scan_slow). 0 disables the tier. Default 25.

long_ban_duration_secs.description: Ban duration of the long-window tier. Default 604800 (7 days).

max_tracked_ips.description: Cap of IPs tracked per tier (memory bound). Default 50000.

ipv6_prefix.description: IPv6 sources are counted and banned per this prefix in both tiers (address rotation inside a /64). 0 or 128 = per address; otherwise 48..128. Default 64.

long_subnet_v4_prefix.description: Distributed slow tier: count distinct ports per IPv4 subnet of this prefix (e.g. 24) within long_window_secs and ban the subnet (port_scan_slow). 0 = off (default); otherwise 16..32.

long_subnet_threshold.description: Distinct ports from one subnet within long_window_secs to fire; 0 disables the subnet tier. Default 40.

long_subnet_min_ips.description: Distinct source addresses of the subnet required to fire. Default 3.
